comparison.objective: Assemble and mesh three gears on assigned shafts by finding tooth phase through contact; candidate adjusts and validates a retained shock absorber setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Gear task tests repeated bore-to-shaft insertion, tooth-phase search, seating, and release. Candidate tests hex-key access, setscrew unlocking, counterheld collar adjustment, controlled relocking, and feedback-driven commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires all gears seated within 2 mm lateral, 1 mm height, and 3° tilt, with both pairs meshed, still, and arms clear. Candidate instead requires two safe dynamic carriage stops within published energy, velocity, and 12 mm stroke limits plus lock-drift verification.
comparison.reason: Both include alignment and rotation, but the gear record tests multi-part keyed-by-contact assembly; it has no adjustable damping, locking fastener, or repeated response-based calibration.
